currentParagraphText: “So definitely valuable,” Jake nodded. He also knew that the reason Identify didn’t work was because the Malefic Viper had blocked the skill. Again, Jake couldn’t even detect they were special with his Bloodline-empowered Perception, but he was fairly confident the bottles were far from the usual ones Jake used. They had to be enchanted with some pretty serious magic.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Hey, I can’t look like a cheapskate,” Villy shrugged. “This will be your first time officially visiting another major faction as my Chosen. It’s a pretty big deal in the grand scheme of things, and it’s only expected that some proper gifts are brought. Plus, the more I give them, the more Nature’s Attendant and Yggdrasil are able to give you in return without it seeming improper.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Eh, I would definitely kill them in return. Probably erase their entire lineages, too. You know, just for good measure. Would make me look weak if I didn’t go a bit overboard with the response,” the Viper shrugged.
